public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI industry cannot be justified by what it does today; it costs too much and none of the businesses built on it are profitable.

statement.excerpt: To be clear, they’re doing so because you can’t really justify anything about this industry based on what it does today. It costs too much, none of the businesses built on top of it are profitable

from_speaker: none of the businesses built on top of it are profitable
our_interpretation: Assess the universal profitability assertion. Costs too much and cannot be justified are judgments without stated tests.
Read businesses built on top of it as businesses whose products substantially depend on LLMs or generative AI.
The ordinary reading of profitable is earning more than all business expenses, rather than having positive gross margins, revenue growth, or financing.
Use April through June 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter that public reporting could cover before the post.
The speaker supplies no accounting basis. Do not silently treat an undefined company profitability statement as net income.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the defined population establishes that no qualifying business earned a profit after all expenses during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one qualifying business documents a positive bottom-line profit during the target period on a defined accounting basis comparable to the claim.
